text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Coordemon] & [Consulmon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Barrier＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may link 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost. [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, if you have 5 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +1 ≪Deck≫＞. Then, to 1 of your opponent's Digimon, give -1000 DP until their turn ends for each of your security cards.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 3 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Linking] Until your opponent's turn ends, their effects can't return this Digimon to hands or decks or affect it with ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects.
